text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second race in her quest for 1st 
place: the Teio Sho. On race day, the 
stands are buzzing with excitement over 
Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon had come to be adored by her 
juniors running in the same race. Her 
waiting room was filled with many 
Umamusume coming to pay their respects.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her juniors as well, she 
wanted to raise the value of dirt racing. 
She wanted to build a world where everyone 
would aim for the dirt tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Holding those feelings close to her heart, 
Smart Falcon headed out to the race.
